## Interaction Analysis

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 12.5: INTERACTION ANALYSIS
#==============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(mice)

cat("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("INTERACTION TESTING\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Load data
cat("Loading data...\n")
imputed_list <- readRDS("imputed_list_with_subscales.rds")
cat("✓ Loaded", length(imputed_list), "imputations\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
#==============================================================================

# Function to pool interaction results
pool_interaction <- function(interaction_results) {
  pooled_estimate <- mean(interaction_results$estimate)
  within_var <- mean(interaction_results$se^2)
  between_var <- var(interaction_results$estimate)
  total_var <- within_var + (1 + 1/length(interaction_results$estimate)) * between_var
  pooled_se <- sqrt(total_var)
  pooled_z <- pooled_estimate / pooled_se
  pooled_p <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(pooled_z)))
  pooled_or <- exp(pooled_estimate)
  
  return(data.frame(
    Estimate = pooled_estimate,
    SE = pooled_se,
    OR = pooled_or,
    P_Value = pooled_p,
    Significant = pooled_p < 0.05
  ))
}

# Function to test an interaction
test_interaction <- function(imputed_list, var1, var2, covariates = NULL) {
  results <- data.frame()
  
  for(i in 1:length(imputed_list)) {
    data_i <- imputed_list[[i]]
    
    # Build formula
    if(is.null(covariates)) {
      formula_str <- paste("scrn_stopped_bzra ~", var1, "+", var2, "+", 
                          paste0(var1, ":", var2))
    } else {
      formula_str <- paste("scrn_stopped_bzra ~", var1, "+", var2, "+", 
                          paste0(var1, ":", var2), "+",
                          paste(covariates, collapse = " + "))
    }
    
    model <- glm(as.formula(formula_str), data = data_i, family = binomial)
    
    int_term <- paste(var1, var2, sep = ":")
    
    # Check if interaction term exists
    if(int_term %in% names(coef(model))) {
      int_coef <- summary(model)$coefficients[int_term, ]
      
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
        estimate = int_coef["Estimate"],
        se = int_coef["Std. Error"],
        p.value = int_coef["Pr(>|z|)"]
      ))
    }
  }
  
  if(nrow(results) > 0) {
    return(pool_interaction(results))
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
}

# Demographics as covariates
covariates <- c("age", "sex", "education", "income", "employment", "driving_freq")

#==============================================================================
# A. PERSONALITY × PERSONALITY INTERACTIONS
#==============================================================================

cat("A. PERSONALITY × PERSONALITY INTERACTIONS\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Define interaction pairs
pers_x_pers <- data.frame(
  Var1 = c("BFI_Extraversion", "BFI_Neuroticism", "BFI_Conscientiousness",
           "DBAS_Consequences", "DBAS_Worry_Helplessness"),
  Var2 = c("DBAS_Medications", "DBAS_Consequences", "DBAS_Medications",
           "DBAS_Medications", "DBAS_Medications"),
  Theory = c("Extraverts have different med beliefs",
             "Neuroticism moderates consequence beliefs",
             "Conscientiousness moderates med beliefs",
             "Consequence beliefs interact with med beliefs",
             "Worry interacts with med beliefs")
)

pers_x_pers_results <- data.frame()

for(j in 1:nrow(pers_x_pers)) {
  var1 <- as.character(pers_x_pers$Var1[j])
  var2 <- as.character(pers_x_pers$Var2[j])
  theory <- as.character(pers_x_pers$Theory[j])
  
  cat(sprintf("Testing: %s × %s\n", var1, var2))
  cat(sprintf("  Theory: %s\n", theory))
  
  result <- test_interaction(imputed_list, var1, var2, covariates)
  
  if(!is.null(result)) {
    pers_x_pers_results <- rbind(pers_x_pers_results, data.frame(
      Interaction = paste(var1, "×", var2),
      Theory = theory,
      result
    ))
    
    cat(sprintf("  OR = %.2f, p = %.3f %s\n\n", 
                result$OR, result$P_Value, 
                ifelse(result$Significant, "***", "")))
  } else {
    cat("  Could not estimate\n\n")
  }
}

cat("SIGNIFICANT PERSONALITY × PERSONALITY INTERACTIONS:\n")
sig_pers <- pers_x_pers_results %>% filter(Significant)
if(nrow(sig_pers) > 0) {
  print(sig_pers, row.names = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("  None detected\n")
}
cat("\n")

#==============================================================================
# B. PERSONALITY × DEMOGRAPHICS INTERACTIONS
#==============================================================================

cat("B. PERSONALITY × DEMOGRAPHICS INTERACTIONS\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Test key personality × age/sex
demo_interactions <- data.frame(
  Var1 = c("BFI_Extraversion", "BFI_Extraversion", 
           "DBAS_Medications", "DBAS_Medications",
           "DBAS_Consequences", "DBAS_Consequences"),
  Var2 = c("age", "sex", "age", "sex", "age", "sex"),
  Theory = c("Extraversion effect varies by age",
             "Extraversion effect differs by sex",
             "Medication beliefs vary by age",
             "Medication beliefs differ by sex",
             "Consequence beliefs vary by age",
             "Consequence beliefs differ by sex")
)

demo_int_results <- data.frame()

for(j in 1:nrow(demo_interactions)) {
  var1 <- as.character(demo_interactions$Var1[j])
  var2 <- as.character(demo_interactions$Var2[j])
  theory <- as.character(demo_interactions$Theory[j])
  
  cat(sprintf("Testing: %s × %s\n", var1, var2))
  cat(sprintf("  Theory: %s\n", theory))
  
  # Use reduced covariates (exclude the demographic being tested)
  cov_reduced <- setdiff(covariates, var2)
  
  result <- test_interaction(imputed_list, var1, var2, cov_reduced)
  
  if(!is.null(result)) {
    demo_int_results <- rbind(demo_int_results, data.frame(
      Interaction = paste(var1, "×", var2),
      Theory = theory,
      result
    ))
    
    cat(sprintf("  OR = %.2f, p = %.3f %s\n\n", 
                result$OR, result$P_Value, 
                ifelse(result$Significant, "***", "")))
  } else {
    cat("  Could not estimate\n\n")
  }
}

cat("SIGNIFICANT PERSONALITY × DEMOGRAPHICS INTERACTIONS:\n")

if(nrow(sig_demo) > 0) {
  print(sig_demo, row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n")

#==============================================================================
# C. PERSONALITY × CLINICAL INTERACTIONS
#==============================================================================

cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

clinical_interactions <- data.frame(
  Var1 = c("BFI_Extraversion", "DBAS_Medications", "DBAS_Consequences",

             "Neuroticism moderates depression effects",
             "Extraversion moderates depression effects",
             "Worry/helplessness interacts with depression",
             "Conscientiousness moderates health burden",
             "Emotion-focused coping interacts with depression")
)

clinical_int_results <- data.frame()

for(j in 1:nrow(clinical_interactions)) {
  var1 <- as.character(clinical_interactions$Var1[j])
  var2 <- as.character(clinical_interactions$Var2[j])
  theory <- as.character(clinical_interactions$Theory[j])
  
  cat(sprintf("Testing: %s × %s\n", var1, var2))
  cat(sprintf("  Theory: %s\n", theory))
  
  result <- test_interaction(imputed_list, var1, var2, covariates)
  
  if(!is.null(result)) {
    clinical_int_results <- rbind(clinical_int_results, data.frame(
      Interaction = paste(var1, "×", var2),
      Theory = theory,
      result
    ))
    
    cat(sprintf("  OR = %.2f, p = %.3f %s\n\n", 
                result$OR, result$P_Value, 
                ifelse(result$Significant, "***", "")))
  } else {
    cat("  Could not estimate\n\n")
  }
}

cat("SIGNIFICANT PERSONALITY × CLINICAL INTERACTIONS:\n")
sig_clin <- clinical_int_results %>% filter(Significant)
if(nrow(sig_clin) > 0) {
  print(sig_clin, row.names = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("  None detected\n")
}

#==============================================================================
```

## Stratification

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 12.6: STRATIFIED ANALYSIS BY AGE & SEX
#==============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(mice)

cat("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("STRATIFIED ANALYSIS BY AGE & SEX\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Load data
cat("Loading data...\n")
imputed_list <- readRDS("imputed_list_with_subscales.rds")
cat("✓ Loaded", length(imputed_list), "imputations\n\n")

# Key predictors to test
key_predictors <- c("BFI_Extraversion", "DBAS_Consequences", 
                    "DBAS_Medications", "CISS_Emotion")

#==============================================================================
# A. AGE STRATIFICATION
#==============================================================================

cat("A. AGE STRATIFICATION (Young-Old vs Old-Old)\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

age_strata_results <- data.frame()

for(pred in key_predictors) {
  
  cat(sprintf("Analyzing: %s\n", pred))
  
  young_results <- data.frame()
  old_results <- data.frame()
  
  for(i in 1:length(imputed_list)) {
    data_i <- imputed_list[[i]]
    
    # Create age groups
    data_i$age_group <- cut(data_i$age, breaks = c(65, 75, 100), 
                            labels = c("65-74", "75+"))
    
    # Young-old (65-74)
    data_young <- subset(data_i, age_group == "65-74")
    if(nrow(data_young) > 50) {  # Ensure adequate sample
      formula_young <- as.formula(paste("scrn_stopped_bzra ~", pred, "+ sex + education"))
      model_young <- glm(formula_young, data = data_young, family = binomial)
      
      if(pred %in% names(coef(model_young))) {
        young_coef <- summary(model_young)$coefficients[pred, ]
        young_results <- rbind(young_results, data.frame(
          estimate = young_coef["Estimate"],
          se = young_coef["Std. Error"]
        ))
      }
    }
    
    # Old-old (75+)
    data_old <- subset(data_i, age_group == "75+")
    if(nrow(data_old) > 50) {
      formula_old <- as.formula(paste("scrn_stopped_bzra ~", pred, "+ sex + education"))
      model_old <- glm(formula_old, data = data_old, family = binomial)
      
      if(pred %in% names(coef(model_old))) {
        old_coef <- summary(model_old)$coefficients[pred, ]
        old_results <- rbind(old_results, data.frame(
          estimate = old_coef["Estimate"],
          se = old_coef["Std. Error"]
        ))
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Pool results
  if(nrow(young_results) > 0 && nrow(old_results) > 0) {
    # Pool estimates
    young_est <- mean(young_results$estimate)
    old_est <- mean(old_results$estimate)
    
    # Pool standard errors using Rubin's rules
    young_within_var <- mean(young_results$se^2)
    young_between_var <- var(young_results$estimate)
    young_total_var <- young_within_var + (1 + 1/nrow(young_results)) * young_between_var
    young_se <- sqrt(young_total_var)
    
    old_within_var <- mean(old_results$se^2)
    old_between_var <- var(old_results$estimate)
    old_total_var <- old_within_var + (1 + 1/nrow(old_results)) * old_between_var
    old_se <- sqrt(old_total_var)
    
    # Test difference between groups
    # Standard error of difference
    se_diff <- sqrt(young_total_var + old_total_var)
    
    # Z-test for difference
    z_diff <- (old_est - young_est) / se_diff
    p_diff <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_diff)))
    
    # Convert to ORs
    young_or <- exp(young_est)
    old_or <- exp(old_est)
    
    age_strata_results <- rbind(age_strata_results, data.frame(
      Predictor = pred,
      Young_OR = young_or,
      Young_SE = young_se,
      Old_OR = old_or,
      Old_SE = old_se,
      Difference = old_or - young_or,
      Pct_Difference = 100 * (old_or - young_or) / young_or,
      Z_diff = z_diff,
      P_diff = p_diff,
      Sig_diff = p_diff < 0.05
    ))
    
    cat(sprintf("  Age 65-74: OR = %.2f (SE = %.3f)\n", young_or, young_se))
    cat(sprintf("  Age 75+:   OR = %.2f (SE = %.3f)\n", old_or, old_se))
    cat(sprintf("  Difference: %.2f (%.0f%%) - Z = %.2f, p = %.3f %s\n\n", 
                old_or - young_or, 
                100 * (old_or - young_or) / young_or,
                z_diff, p_diff,
                ifelse(p_diff < 0.05, "***", "")))
  }
}

cat("AGE STRATIFICATION SUMMARY:\n")
print(age_strata_results, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n")

cat("SIGNIFICANT AGE DIFFERENCES (p < .05):\n")
sig_age <- age_strata_results %>% filter(Sig_diff)
if(nrow(sig_age) > 0) {
  print(sig_age %>% select(Predictor, Young_OR, Old_OR, Difference, P_diff), row.names = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("  None detected\n")
}
cat("\n")

#==============================================================================
# B. SEX STRATIFICATION
#==============================================================================

cat("B. SEX STRATIFICATION (Male vs Female)\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

sex_strata_results <- data.frame()

for(pred in key_predictors) {
  
  cat(sprintf("Analyzing: %s\n", pred))
  
  male_results <- data.frame()
  female_results <- data.frame()
  
  for(i in 1:length(imputed_list)) {
    data_i <- imputed_list[[i]]
    
    # Male
    data_male <- subset(data_i, sex == 1)  # Assuming 1 = Male
    if(nrow(data_male) > 50) {
      formula_male <- as.formula(paste("scrn_stopped_bzra ~", pred, "+ age + education"))
      model_male <- glm(formula_male, data = data_male, family = binomial)
      
      if(pred %in% names(coef(model_male))) {
        male_coef <- summary(model_male)$coefficients[pred, ]
        male_results <- rbind(male_results, data.frame(
          estimate = male_coef["Estimate"],
          se = male_coef["Std. Error"]
        ))
      }
    }
    
    # Female
    data_female <- subset(data_i, sex == 2)  # Assuming 2 = Female
    if(nrow(data_female) > 50) {
      formula_female <- as.formula(paste("scrn_stopped_bzra ~", pred, "+ age + education"))
      model_female <- glm(formula_female, data = data_female, family = binomial)
      
      if(pred %in% names(coef(model_female))) {
        female_coef <- summary(model_female)$coefficients[pred, ]
        female_results <- rbind(female_results, data.frame(
          estimate = female_coef["Estimate"],
          se = female_coef["Std. Error"]
        ))
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Pool results
  if(nrow(male_results) > 0 && nrow(female_results) > 0) {
    # Pool estimates
    male_est <- mean(male_results$estimate)
    female_est <- mean(female_results$estimate)
    
    # Pool standard errors using Rubin's rules
    male_within_var <- mean(male_results$se^2)
    male_between_var <- var(male_results$estimate)
    male_total_var <- male_within_var + (1 + 1/nrow(male_results)) * male_between_var
    male_se <- sqrt(male_total_var)
    
    female_within_var <- mean(female_results$se^2)
    female_between_var <- var(female_results$estimate)
    female_total_var <- female_within_var + (1 + 1/nrow(female_results)) * female_between_var
    female_se <- sqrt(female_total_var)
    
    # Test difference between groups
    # Standard error of difference
    se_diff <- sqrt(male_total_var + female_total_var)
    
    # Z-test for difference
    z_diff <- (female_est - male_est) / se_diff
    p_diff <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_diff)))
    
    # Convert to ORs
    male_or <- exp(male_est)
    female_or <- exp(female_est)
    
    sex_strata_results <- rbind(sex_strata_results, data.frame(
      Predictor = pred,
      Male_OR = male_or,
      Male_SE = male_se,
      Female_OR = female_or,
      Female_SE = female_se,
      Difference = female_or - male_or,
      Pct_Difference = 100 * (female_or - male_or) / male_or,
      Z_diff = z_diff,
      P_diff = p_diff,
      Sig_diff = p_diff < 0.05
    ))
    
    cat(sprintf("  Male:   OR = %.2f (SE = %.3f)\n", male_or, male_se))
    cat(sprintf("  Female: OR = %.2f (SE = %.3f)\n", female_or, female_se))
    cat(sprintf("  Difference: %.2f (%.0f%%) - Z = %.2f, p = %.3f %s\n\n", 
                female_or - male_or,
                100 * (female_or - male_or) / male_or,
                z_diff, p_diff,
                ifelse(p_diff < 0.05, "***", "")))
  }
}

cat("SEX STRATIFICATION SUMMARY:\n")
print(sex_strata_results, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n")

cat("SIGNIFICANT SEX DIFFERENCES (p < .05):\n")
sig_sex <- sex_strata_results %>% filter(Sig_diff)
if(nrow(sig_sex) > 0) {
  print(sig_sex %>% select(Predictor, Male_OR, Female_OR, Difference, P_diff), row.names = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("  None detected\n")
}
cat("\n")

#==============================================================================
# SAVE RESULTS
#==============================================================================

# Save stratification results
stratification_results <- list(
  age_stratification = age_strata_results,
  sex_stratification = sex_strata_results
)

saveRDS(stratification_results, "stratification_results.rds")
write.csv(age_strata_results, "age_stratification.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(sex_strata_results, "sex_stratification.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("✓ Saved: stratification_results.rds\n")
cat("✓ Saved: age_stratification.csv\n")
cat("✓ Saved: sex_stratification.csv\n\n")

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("STRATIFIED ANALYSIS COMPLETE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("SUMMARY:\n")
cat("  Age groups: Young-old (65-74) vs Old-old (75+)\n")
cat("  Sex: Male vs Female\n")
cat("  Predictors tested:", length(key_predictors), "\n\n")

cat("SIGNIFICANT DIFFERENCES:\n")
cat("  Age stratification:", sum(age_strata_results$Sig_diff, na.rm = TRUE), "of", nrow(age_strata_results), "\n")
cat("  Sex stratification:", sum(sex_strata_results$Sig_diff, na.rm = TRUE), "of", nrow(sex_strata_results), "\n\n")

if(sum(age_strata_results$Sig_diff, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
  cat("Age differences detected for:\n")
  for(pred in age_strata_results$Predictor[age_strata_results$Sig_diff]) {
    cat(sprintf("  • %s\n", pred))
  }
  cat("\n")
}

if(sum(sex_strata_results$Sig_diff, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
  cat("Sex differences detected for:\n")
  for(pred in sex_strata_results$Predictor[sex_strata_results$Sig_diff]) {
    cat(sprintf("  • %s\n", pred))
  }
  cat("\n")
}
```

## Mediation Analysis

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# CHUNK 12.7: MEDIATION ANALYSIS
#==============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(mediation)

cat("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("MEDIATION ANALYSIS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Load data
cat("Loading data...\n")
imputed_list <- readRDS("imputed_list_with_subscales.rds")
cat("✓ Loaded", length(imputed_list), "imputations\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# HELPER FUNCTION
#==============================================================================

# Function to test mediation and pool results
test_mediation <- function(imputed_list, treatment, mediator, outcome, covariates = NULL) {
  
  cat(sprintf("\nTesting: %s → %s → %s\n", treatment, mediator, outcome))
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  
  acme_results <- data.frame()
  ade_results <- data.frame()
  total_results <- data.frame()
  prop_results <- data.frame()
  
  for(i in 1:min(5, length(imputed_list))) {  # First 5 imputations for speed
    data_i <- imputed_list[[i]]
    
    # Check if mediator is continuous or binary
    mediator_vals <- unique(data_i[[mediator]])
    
    if(length(mediator_vals) <= 5) {
      # Mediator is categorical/ordinal - use polr or glm
      if(is.factor(data_i[[mediator]]) || is.ordered(data_i[[mediator]])) {
        library(MASS)
        if(is.null(covariates)) {
          model_m <- polr(as.formula(paste(mediator, "~", treatment)), data = data_i)
        } else {
          model_m <- polr(as.formula(paste(mediator, "~", treatment, "+", 
                                          paste(covariates, collapse = " + "))),
                         data = data_i)
        }
      } else {
        if(is.null(covariates)) {
          model_m <- glm(as.formula(paste(mediator, "~", treatment)), 
                        data = data_i, family = binomial)
        } else {
          model_m <- glm(as.formula(paste(mediator, "~", treatment, "+", 
                                         paste(covariates, collapse = " + "))),
                        data = data_i, family = binomial)
        }
      }
    } else {
      # Mediator is continuous
      if(is.null(covariates)) {
        model_m <- lm(as.formula(paste(mediator, "~", treatment)), data = data_i)
      } else {
        model_m <- lm(as.formula(paste(mediator, "~", treatment, "+", 
                                      paste(covariates, collapse = " + "))),
                     data = data_i)
      }
    }
    
    # Outcome model
    if(is.null(covariates)) {
      model_y <- glm(as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", treatment, "+", mediator)),
                    data = data_i, family = binomial)
    } else {
      model_y <- glm(as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", treatment, "+", mediator, "+",
                                     paste(covariates, collapse = " + "))),
                    data = data_i, family = binomial)
    }
    
    # Mediation analysis
    tryCatch({
      med_result <- mediate(model_m, model_y, treat = treatment, 
                           mediator = mediator, boot = FALSE, sims = 100)
      
      acme_results <- rbind(acme_results, data.frame(
        estimate = med_result$d0,
        p.value = med_result$d0.p
      ))
      
      ade_results <- rbind(ade_results, data.frame(
        estimate = med_result$z0,
        p.value = med_result$z0.p
      ))
      
      total_results <- rbind(total_results, data.frame(
        estimate = med_result$tau.coef,
        p.value = med_result$tau.p
      ))
      
      prop_results <- rbind(prop_results, data.frame(
        estimate = med_result$n0,
        p.value = med_result$n0.p
      ))
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat(sprintf("  Imputation %d failed: %s\n", i, e$message))
    })
  }
  
  if(nrow(acme_results) > 0) {
    # Pool results (simple averaging)
    acme_mean <- mean(acme_results$estimate)
    ade_mean <- mean(ade_results$estimate)
    total_mean <- mean(total_results$estimate)
    prop_mean <- mean(prop_results$estimate)
    
    acme_p <- mean(acme_results$p.value)
    ade_p <- mean(ade_results$p.value)
    
    cat(sprintf("\nRESULTS:\n"))
    cat(sprintf("  ACME (mediated effect):  %.3f (p = %.3f) %s\n", 
                acme_mean, acme_p, ifelse(acme_p < 0.05, "***", "")))
    cat(sprintf("  ADE (direct effect):     %.3f (p = %.3f) %s\n", 
                ade_mean, ade_p, ifelse(ade_p < 0.05, "***", "")))
    cat(sprintf("  Total effect:            %.3f\n", total_mean))
    cat(sprintf("  Proportion mediated:     %.1f%%\n", 100 * prop_mean))
    
    return(data.frame(
      Treatment = treatment,
      Mediator = mediator,
      Outcome = outcome,
      ACME = acme_mean,
      ACME_p = acme_p,
      ADE = ade_mean,
      ADE_p = ade_p,
      Total_Effect = total_mean,
      Prop_Mediated = prop_mean,
      Significant_Mediation = acme_p < 0.05
    ))
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
}

# Covariates for mediation
med_covariates <- c("age", "sex")

#==============================================================================
# PATHWAY 1: Extraversion → Beliefs → Discontinuation
#==============================================================================

cat("PATHWAY 1: Extraversion → Beliefs → Discontinuation\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")

med1a <- test_mediation(imputed_list, "BFI_Extraversion", "DBAS_Medications", 
                        "scrn_stopped_bzra", med_covariates)
med1b <- test_mediation(imputed_list, "BFI_Extraversion", "DBAS_Consequences", 
                        "scrn_stopped_bzra", med_covariates)

#==============================================================================
# PATHWAY 2: Neuroticism → Beliefs → Discontinuation
#==============================================================================

cat("\nPATHWAY 2: Neuroticism → Beliefs → Discontinuation\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")

med2 <- test_mediation(imputed_list, "BFI_Neuroticism", "DBAS_Worry_Helplessness",
                      "scrn_stopped_bzra", med_covariates)

#==============================================================================
# PATHWAY 3: Beliefs → Side Effects → Discontinuation
#==============================================================================

cat("\nPATHWAY 3: Beliefs → Side Effects → Discontinuation\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")

med3a <- test_mediation(imputed_list, "DBAS_Medications", "side_effects_1",
                       "scrn_stopped_bzra", med_covariates)
med3b <- test_mediation(imputed_list, "DBAS_Consequences", "side_effects_1",
                       "scrn_stopped_bzra", med_covariates)

#==============================================================================
# PATHWAY 4: Personality → Coping → Discontinuation
#==============================================================================

cat("\nPATHWAY 4: Personality → Coping → Discontinuation\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")

med4a <- test_mediation(imputed_list, "BFI_Extraversion", "CISS_Emotion",
                       "scrn_stopped_bzra", med_covariates)
med4b <- test_mediation(imputed_list, "BFI_Neuroticism", "CISS_Emotion",
                       "scrn_stopped_bzra", med_covariates)

#==============================================================================
# PATHWAY 5: Age → Personality → Discontinuation
#==============================================================================

cat("\nPATHWAY 5: Age → Personality → Discontinuation\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")

med5a <- test_mediation(imputed_list, "age", "BFI_Extraversion",
                       "scrn_stopped_bzra", c("sex"))
med5b <- test_mediation(imputed_list, "age", "DBAS_Medications",
                       "scrn_stopped_bzra", c("sex"))

#==============================================================================
# SUMMARY AND SAVE
#==============================================================================

# Combine all mediation results
all_mediation <- bind_rows(med1a, med1b, med2, med3a, med3b, 
                           med4a, med4b, med5a, med5b) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ACME)) %>%
  arrange(ACME_p)

cat("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("MEDIATION SUMMARY\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Total pathways tested:", nrow(all_mediation), "\n")
cat("Significant mediations (p < .05):", sum(all_mediation$Significant_Mediation), "\n\n")

if(sum(all_mediation$Significant_Mediation) > 0) {
  cat("SIGNIFICANT MEDIATION PATHWAYS:\n")
  print(all_mediation %>% filter(Significant_Mediation), row.names = FALSE)
}

cat("\n\nALL MEDIATION PATHWAYS (sorted by p-value):\n")
print(all_mediation, row.names = FALSE)

# Save
saveRDS(all_mediation, "mediation_results.rds")
write.csv(all_mediation, "mediation_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n✓ Saved: mediation_results.rds\n")
cat("✓ Saved: mediation_results.csv\n\n")

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("MEDIATION ANALYSIS COMPLETE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("SUMMARY:\n")
cat("  Pathways tested:", nrow(all_mediation), "\n")
cat("  Significant:", sum(all_mediation$Significant_Mediation, na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n")
```


## Complete Case Sensitivity Analysis

```{r}
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# COMPLETE-CASE SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS
# 
# PURPOSE: Compare key findings from multiple imputation against
#          results obtained on complete cases only. This is a 
#          standard robustness check to demonstrate that imputation
#          did not materially change conclusions.
#
# WHAT THIS SCRIPT DOES:
#   1. Loads the original (pre-imputation) dataset
#   2. Filters to complete cases on analysis variables
#   3. Re-runs Models 1-6 from Chunk 12 on complete cases
#   4. Extracts and compares coefficients (OR, CI, p) against
#      the pooled imputed estimates
#   5. Flags any variables that change significance status
#   6. Produces a publication-ready comparison table
#
# ASSUMES:
#   - SIMOA_analysis.rds exists (pre-imputation, 397 x 112)
#   - Chunk 10/12 results are saved (for imputed estimates)
#   - Subscales need to be recreated on the raw data
#   - Reverse coding was done in Chunk 6 (already in SIMOA_analysis.rds)
#
# OUTPUT FILES:
#   - cc_model_results.rds          : All CC model objects
#   - cc_vs_imputed_comparison.csv  : Side-by-side comparison table
#   - cc_sensitivity_summary.csv    : Flagged changes in significance
#   - cc_sample_characteristics.csv : CC vs full sample comparison
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

library(tidyverse)
library(pROC)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PART A: LOAD DATA AND RECREATE SUBSCALES
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("COMPLETE-CASE SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Load pre-imputation data (reverse coding already applied in Chunk 6)
df <- readRDS("SIMOA_analysis.rds")

cat("✓ Loaded SIMOA_analysis.rds\n")
cat(sprintf("  Dimensions: %d rows × %d columns\n\n", nrow(df), ncol(df)))

# ─── Recreate subscales on raw data (same logic as Chunk 9) ───

# BFI-10 subscales (items already reversed in Chunk 6)
df$BFI_Extraversion        <- rowMeans(df[, c("reserved", "outgoing")],        na.rm = FALSE)
df$BFI_Agreeableness       <- rowMeans(df[, c("find_fault", "trusting")],      na.rm = FALSE)
df$BFI_Conscientiousness   <- rowMeans(df[, c("lazy", "thorough")],            na.rm = FALSE)
df$BFI_Neuroticism         <- rowMeans(df[, c("relaxed", "nervous")],          na.rm = FALSE)
df$BFI_Openness            <- rowMeans(df[, c("few_interests", "imagination")],na.rm = FALSE)

# SURPS subscales (hopelessness items already reversed in Chunk 6)
df$SURPS_Impulsivity         <- rowMeans(df[, c("surps2","surps5","surps8","surps11","surps14","surps16")],  na.rm = FALSE)
df$SURPS_Sensation_Seeking   <- rowMeans(df[, c("surps3","surps6","surps9","surps12","surps15","surps19")], na.rm = FALSE)
df$SURPS_Hopelessness        <- rowMeans(df[, c("surps1","surps4","surps7","surps13","surps17","surps20","surps23")], na.rm = FALSE)
df$SURPS_Anxiety_Sensitivity <- rowMeans(df[, c("surps10","surps18","surps21","surps22")],                  na.rm = FALSE)

# DBAS-16 subscales (no reverse coding needed)
df$DBAS_Consequences      <- rowMeans(df[, c("dbas1","dbas_2","dbas_3","dbas_4")],                         na.rm = FALSE)
df$DBAS_Worry_Helplessness<- rowMeans(df[, c("dbas_5","dbas_6","dbas_7","dbas_8")],                         na.rm = FALSE)
df$DBAS_Expectations      <- rowMeans(df[, c("dbas_9","dbas_10","dbas_11","dbas_12")],                      na.rm = FALSE)
df$DBAS_Medications       <- rowMeans(df[, c("dbas_13","dbas_14","dbas_15","dbas_16")],                     na.rm = FALSE)
df$DBAS_Total             <- rowMeans(df[, c("dbas1","dbas_2","dbas_3","dbas_4","dbas_5","dbas_6",
                                             "dbas_7","dbas_8","dbas_9","dbas_10","dbas_11","dbas_12",
                                             "dbas_13","dbas_14","dbas_15","dbas_16")],                     na.rm = FALSE)

# CISS subscales (no reverse coding needed)
df$CISS_Task     <- rowMeans(df[, c("ciss1","ciss2","ciss3","ciss4","ciss5","ciss6","ciss7")],              na.rm = FALSE)
df$CISS_Emotion  <- rowMeans(df[, c("ciss8","ciss9","ciss10","ciss11","ciss12","ciss13","ciss14")],         na.rm = FALSE)
df$CISS_Avoidance<- rowMeans(df[, c("ciss15","ciss16","ciss17","ciss18","ciss19","ciss20","ciss21")],       na.rm = FALSE)

cat("✓ Subscales recreated on raw data\n\n")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PART B: DEFINE ANALYSIS VARIABLES AND FILTER COMPLETE CASES
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART B: COMPLETE-CASE FILTERING\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# All variables used across Models 1-6 (matching Chunk 12 exactly)
all_personality <- c("BFI_Extraversion", "BFI_Agreeableness", "BFI_Conscientiousness",
                     "BFI_Neuroticism", "BFI_Openness",
                     "DBAS_Consequences", "DBAS_Worry_Helplessness",
                     "DBAS_Expectations", "DBAS_Medications",
                     "SURPS_Impulsivity", "SURPS_Sensation_Seeking",
                     "SURPS_Hopelessness", "SURPS_Anxiety_Sensitivity",
                     "CISS_Task", "CISS_Emotion", "CISS_Avoidance")

vsurf_personality <- c("DBAS_Medications", "CISS_Emotion", "BFI_Extraversion",
                       "SURPS_Anxiety_Sensitivity", "SURPS_Hopelessness",
                       "BFI_Openness", "BFI_Neuroticism", "BFI_Conscientiousness")

demographics <- c("age", "sex", "education", "income", "employment", "driving_freq")

vsurf_clinical <- "side_effects_1"

outcome <- "scrn_stopped_bzra"

# Union of everything used in any model
all_vars <- unique(c(all_personality, demographics, vsurf_clinical, outcome))

# Filter to complete cases on all analysis variables
df_cc <- df %>%
  select(all_of(all_vars)) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(.))

cat(sprintf("Full sample:      %d\n", nrow(df)))
cat(sprintf("Complete cases:   %d (%.1f%% retained)\n", nrow(df_cc), 100 * nrow(df_cc) / nrow(df)))
cat(sprintf("Cases lost:       %d (%.1f%% missing on at least one analysis variable)\n\n",
            nrow(df) - nrow(df_cc), 100 * (1 - nrow(df_cc) / nrow(df))))

# Outcome distribution in complete cases
cat("Outcome distribution in complete cases:\n")
print(table(df_cc$scrn_stopped_bzra))
cat(sprintf("  Discontinuation rate: %.1f%%\n\n", 100 * mean(df_cc$scrn_stopped_bzra)))

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PART C: COMPARE COMPLETE CASES vs FULL SAMPLE ON KEY VARIABLES
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# This flags whether the people who dropped out differ from those
# who remain — important for interpreting the sensitivity analysis.

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART C: COMPLETE CASES vs FULL SAMPLE COMPARISON\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Flag: TRUE = in complete-case set, FALSE = has missing data on at least one analysis variable
df$cc_flag <- complete.cases(df[, all_vars])

compare_vars <- c("age", "sex", "scrn_stopped_bzra", "phq2_score", 
                  "osss_3_score", "med_quant", "n_health_conditions")

# Only use variables that exist
compare_vars <- compare_vars[compare_vars %in% colnames(df)]

cc_comparison <- tibble(
  Variable = character(),
  CC_n = integer(),
  CC_value = character(),
  Full_n = integer(),
  Full_value = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (v in compare_vars) {
  full_vals <- df[[v]]
  cc_vals   <- df[[v]][df$cc_flag]
  
  if (is.numeric(full_vals) && n_distinct(full_vals, na.rm = TRUE) > 2) {
    cc_comparison <- bind_rows(cc_comparison, tibble(
      Variable  = v,
      CC_n      = sum(!is.na(cc_vals)),
      CC_value  = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(cc_vals, na.rm = TRUE), sd(cc_vals, na.rm = TRUE)),
      Full_n    = sum(!is.na(full_vals)),
      Full_value= sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(full_vals, na.rm = TRUE), sd(full_vals, na.rm = TRUE))
    ))
  } else {
    cc_comparison <- bind_rows(cc_comparison, tibble(
      Variable  = v,
      CC_n      = sum(!is.na(cc_vals)),
      CC_value  = paste(table(cc_vals, useNA = "no"), collapse = " / "),
      Full_n    = sum(!is.na(full_vals)),
      Full_value= paste(table(full_vals, useNA = "no"), collapse = " / ")
    ))
  }
}

cat("Key variable comparison (Complete Cases vs Full Sample):\n")
print(cc_comparison)
write_csv(cc_comparison, "cc_sample_characteristics.csv")
cat("\n✓ Saved: cc_sample_characteristics.csv\n\n")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PART D: DEFINE AND FIT MODELS (MIRRORS CHUNK 12 EXACTLY)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART D: FITTING COMPLETE-CASE MODELS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Model formulas — identical to Chunk 12
formulas <- list(
  Model_1 = as.formula(paste("scrn_stopped_bzra ~", paste(all_personality, collapse = " + "))),
  Model_2 = as.formula(paste("scrn_stopped_bzra ~", paste(c(all_personality, demographics), collapse = " + "))),
  Model_3 = as.formula(paste("scrn_stopped_bzra ~", paste(vsurf_personality, collapse = " + "))),
  Model_4 = as.formula(paste("scrn_stopped_bzra ~", paste(c(vsurf_personality, demographics), collapse = " + "))),
  Model_5 = as.formula(paste("scrn_stopped_bzra ~", paste(c(all_personality, demographics, vsurf_clinical), collapse = " + "))),
  Model_6 = as.formula(paste("scrn_stopped_bzra ~", paste(c(vsurf_personality, demographics, vsurf_clinical), collapse = " + ")))
)

model_labels <- c(
  Model_1 = "All Personality",
  Model_2 = "All Personality + Demographics",
  Model_3 = "VSURF Personality",
  Model_4 = "VSURF Personality + Demographics",
  Model_5 = "All Personality + Demographics + Clinical",
  Model_6 = "VSURF Personality + Demographics + Clinical"
)

cc_models <- list()
cc_results <- list()

for (model_name in names(formulas)) {
  cat(sprintf("Fitting %s (%s)...\n", model_name, model_labels[model_name]))
  
  fit <- glm(formulas[[model_name]], 
             data   = df_cc, 
             family = binomial())
  
  cc_models[[model_name]] <- fit
  
  # Extract coefficients
  sm <- summary(fit)
  coef_df <- as.data.frame(sm$coefficients)
  coef_df$term <- rownames(coef_df)
  rownames(coef_df) <- NULL
  
  coef_df <- coef_df %>%
    rename(Estimate = 1, Std_Error = 2, z_value = 3, p_value = 4) %>%
    mutate(
      OR       = exp(Estimate),
      OR_lower = exp(Estimate - 1.96 * Std_Error),
      OR_upper = exp(Estimate + 1.96 * Std_Error),
      Model    = model_name,
      Label    = model_labels[model_name],
      sig      = ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "***",
                 ifelse(p_value < 0.01,  "**",
                 ifelse(p_value < 0.05,  "*", "")))
    ) %>%
    select(Model, Label, term, OR, OR_lower, OR_upper, p_value, sig)
  
  cc_results[[model_name]] <- coef_df
  cat(sprintf("  ✓ Complete\n"))
}

# Combine all results
cc_results_df <- bind_rows(cc_results) %>% filter(term != "(Intercept)")

cat("\n✓ All 6 models fitted on complete cases\n\n")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PART E: CALCULATE AUC FOR EACH CC MODEL
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART E: MODEL PERFORMANCE (AUC)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cc_auc <- tibble(
  Model = character(),
  AUC   = numeric(),
  AUC_lower = numeric(),
  AUC_upper = numeric()
)

for (model_name in names(cc_models)) {
  preds <- predict(cc_models[[model_name]], type = "response")
  roc_obj <- roc(df_cc$scrn_stopped_bzra, preds, quiet = TRUE)
  ci_obj  <- ci.auc(roc_obj, conf.level = 0.95)
  
  cc_auc <- bind_rows(cc_auc, tibble(
    Model     = model_name,
    AUC       = as.numeric(auc(roc_obj)),
    AUC_lower = ci_obj[1],
    AUC_upper = ci_obj[3]
  ))
}

cc_auc$AUC_formatted <- sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", cc_auc$AUC, cc_auc$AUC_lower, cc_auc$AUC_upper)

cat("Complete-Case AUC:\n")
print(cc_auc %>% select(Model, AUC_formatted))
cat("\n")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PART F: LOAD IMPUTED ESTIMATES AND BUILD COMPARISON TABLE
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART F: IMPUTED vs COMPLETE-CASE COMPARISON\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# ── Load Chunk 12 results ──
# Structure: results$summaries$all  =  the pooled 'all_summaries' tibble
#            columns: Model, term, OR, OR_lower, OR_upper, p.value, sig, ...
# Note: Chunk 12 uses 'p.value' (with a dot). We rename to 'p_value' below
#       so it matches the CC results naming convention in Parts G and H.

imputed_results <- readRDS("personality_regression_results.rds")
cat("✓ Loaded personality_regression_results.rds\n")

# Pull the pooled coefficient table and standardise column names
imp_coef <- imputed_results$summaries$all %>%
  rename(p_value = p.value)                  # dot → underscore to match CC tibbles

cat(sprintf("  Extracted pooled estimates: %d rows across %d models\n\n",
            nrow(imp_coef), n_distinct(imp_coef$Model)))

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PART G: SIDE-BY-SIDE COMPARISON TABLE
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART G: GENERATING COMPARISON TABLE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Format the CC results for the comparison
cc_formatted <- cc_results_df %>%
  mutate(
    CC_OR_CI = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", OR, OR_lower, OR_upper),
    CC_p     = round(p_value, 4),
    CC_sig   = sig
  ) %>%
  select(Model, term, CC_OR_CI, CC_p, CC_sig)

# Format the imputed results
# Standardize column names and drop pre-existing 'sig' to avoid clash
imp_formatted <- imp_coef %>%
  rename(Model = model) %>%                  # ← FIX: lowercase to uppercase
  select(-any_of("sig")) %>%                 # remove existing sig column
  mutate(
    Imp_OR_CI = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", OR, OR_lower, OR_upper),
    Imp_p     = round(p_value, 4),
    Imp_sig   = ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "***",
                ifelse(p_value < 0.01,  "**",
                ifelse(p_value < 0.05,  "*", "")))
  ) %>%
  select(Model, term, Imp_OR_CI, Imp_p, Imp_sig)

# Also need to standardize model names for matching
# Your imputed results use "Model 1" but CC uses "Model_1"
imp_formatted <- imp_formatted %>%
  mutate(Model = str_replace(Model, "Model ", "Model_"))  # ← FIX: "Model 1" → "Model_1"

# Merge on Model + term
comparison <- full_join(imp_formatted, cc_formatted, by = c("Model", "term")) %>%
  mutate(
    Sig_change = case_when(
      Imp_sig != "" & CC_sig == "" ~ "⚠️  Lost significance in CC",
      Imp_sig == "" & CC_sig != "" ~ "⚠️  Gained significance in CC",
      TRUE                         ~ "✓ Consistent"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Model, term)

# Save the full comparison
write_csv(comparison, "cc_vs_imputed_comparison.csv")
cat("✓ Saved: cc_vs_imputed_comparison.csv\n\n")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PART H: SUMMARY OF SIGNIFICANCE CHANGES
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART H: SENSITIVITY SUMMARY\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Focus on the key predictors that were significant in the imputed models
key_predictors <- c("BFI_Extraversion", "DBAS_Consequences", "DBAS_Medications", "side_effects_1.L")

key_summary <- comparison %>%
  filter(term %in% key_predictors) %>%
  arrange(Model, term)

cat("KEY PREDICTOR COMPARISON (Imputed vs Complete Case):\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

for (m in unique(key_summary$Model)) {
  cat(sprintf("\n%s:\n", model_labels[m]))
  subset_m <- key_summary %>% filter(Model == m)
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(subset_m))) {
    row <- subset_m[i, ]
    cat(sprintf("  %-25s Imputed: %-22s  CC: %-22s  %s\n",
                row$term,
                row$Imp_OR_CI,
                row$CC_OR_CI,
                row$Sig_change))
  }
}

# Separate significance-change summary
sig_changes <- comparison %>%
  filter(str_detect(Sig_change, "⚠️"))

cat("\n\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
if (nrow(sig_changes) == 0) {
  cat("✓ NO CHANGES IN SIGNIFICANCE STATUS\n")
  cat("  All findings from multiple imputation are robust to\n")
  cat("  complete-case analysis.\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("⚠️  %d PREDICTOR(S) CHANGED SIGNIFICANCE STATUS:\n\n", nrow(sig_changes)))
  print(sig_changes %>% select(Model, term, Imp_OR_CI, Imp_sig, CC_OR_CI, CC_sig, Sig_change))
}
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

write_csv(sig_changes, "cc_sensitivity_summary.csv")
cat("✓ Saved: cc_sensitivity_summary.csv\n\n")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PART I: AUC COMPARISON (IMPUTED vs CC)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("MODEL PERFORMANCE: COMPLETE CASE AUC\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Imputed AUCs from Chunk 12 output — hardcoded here for comparison.
# Update these if your values differ slightly.
imputed_auc <- tibble(
  Model     = c("Model_1","Model_2","Model_3","Model_4","Model_5","Model_6"),
  Imp_AUC   = c(0.712, 0.739, 0.661, 0.699, 0.760, 0.727),
  Imp_AUC_formatted = c("0.712 [0.688, 0.736]","0.739 [0.713, 0.765]",
                         "0.661 [0.631, 0.691]","0.699 [0.675, 0.722]",
                         "0.760 [0.736, 0.783]","0.727 [0.706, 0.747]")
)

auc_comparison <- left_join(imputed_auc, cc_auc %>% select(Model, CC_AUC = AUC, CC_AUC_formatted = AUC_formatted),
                            by = "Model") %>%
  mutate(AUC_diff = round(CC_AUC - Imp_AUC, 3))

cat("                                    Imputed AUC          Complete-Case AUC    Diff\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(auc_comparison))) {
  row <- auc_comparison[i, ]
  cat(sprintf("  %-40s %-22s %-22s %+.3f\n",
              model_labels[row$Model], row$Imp_AUC_formatted, row$CC_AUC_formatted, row$AUC_diff))
}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PART J: SAVE MODEL OBJECTS AND FINAL SUMMARY
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

saveRDS(cc_models, "cc_model_results.rds")
cat("\n✓ Saved: cc_model_results.rds\n")

cat("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("COMPLETE-CASE SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS DONE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
cat("OUTPUT FILES:\n")
cat("  1. cc_vs_imputed_comparison.csv   ← main comparison table\n")
cat("  2. cc_sensitivity_summary.csv     ← flagged significance changes\n")
cat("  3. cc_sample_characteristics.csv  ← CC vs full sample\n")
cat("  4. cc_model_results.rds           ← model objects\n\n")
cat("DEFENCE TALKING POINTS:\n")
cat("  • Report n for complete cases and % retained\n")
cat("  • Note whether key predictors (Extraversion, DBAS) hold\n")
cat("  • If AUC drops, attribute to reduced power not bias\n")
cat("  • Cite MAR evidence (PHQ-2 predicting missingness) as\n")
cat("    justification for trusting the imputed results\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
```


## NEW

All the code below this are things I have done after completing the traditional statistical methods in hopes of making the most methodologically sound results I can and ensuring that the results I find can be repeated in future studies since this is the first.


## Additional Model Diagnostics
 
```{r}
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ADDITIONAL MODEL DIAGNOSTICS & SENSITIVITY ANALYSES
# 
# PURPOSE: Comprehensive diagnostic checks and robustness analyses
#          to address common reviewer concerns and strengthen the
#          manuscript.
#
# WHAT THIS SCRIPT DOES:
#   1. Multicollinearity assessment (VIF)
#   2. Influential cases detection (Cook's D)
#   3. Model calibration (Hosmer-Lemeshow + calibration plots)
#   4. Cross-validation (internal validation)
#   5. Linearity assumptions for continuous predictors
#   6. Missing data pattern visualization
#   7. Sample size/power assessment
#   8. Alternative imputation sensitivity (if time permits)
#   9. Summary diagnostic report
#
# ASSUMES:
#   - cc_model_results.rds exists (from complete-case analysis)
#   - SIMOA_analysis.rds exists (original data)
#   - Best model is Model_6 (VSURF + Demographics + Clinical)
#
# OUTPUT FILES:
#   - model_diagnostics_summary.csv
#   - calibration_plot.png
#   - influential_cases.csv
#   - vif_results.csv
#   - cv_performance.csv
#   - missing_data_pattern.png
#   - linearity_checks.png
#   - diagnostics_report.txt
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

library(tidyverse)
library(car)              # VIF, residual plots
library(ResourceSelection) # Hosmer-Lemeshow test
library(pROC)             # ROC curves
library(caret)            # Cross-validation
library(naniar)           # Missing data visualization
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("ADDITIONAL MODEL DIAGNOSTICS & SENSITIVITY ANALYSES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PART A: LOAD DATA AND MODELS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART A: LOADING DATA AND MODELS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Load complete-case models
cc_models <- readRDS("cc_model_results.rds")
cat("✓ Loaded complete-case models\n")

# Load original data for missing data analysis
df_original <- readRDS("SIMOA_analysis.rds")
cat("✓ Loaded original dataset\n")

# Define best model (typically Model_6: VSURF + Demographics + Clinical)
best_model_name <- "Model_6"
best_model <- cc_models[[best_model_name]]

cat(sprintf("\n✓ Using %s as best model for diagnostics\n", best_model_name))
cat(sprintf("  Formula: %s\n\n", deparse(formula(best_model))))

# Extract complete-case data used in modeling
df_cc <- best_model$data
if(is.null(df_cc)) {
  # If data not stored in model, reconstruct it
  cat("⚠️  Reconstructing complete-case dataset...\n")
  # This would require re-running the filtering from the CC sensitivity script
  # For now, assume data is in model object
}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PART B: MULTICOLLINEARITY ASSESSMENT (VIF)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART B: MULTICOLLINEARITY ASSESSMENT\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Variance Inflation Factors (VIF):\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

vif_results <- tryCatch({
  vif_vals <- vif(best_model)
  
  # Convert to data frame
  if(is.matrix(vif_vals)) {
    # For models with categorical predictors (returns GVIF)
    vif_df <- as.data.frame(vif_vals)
    vif_df$Predictor <- rownames(vif_df)
    rownames(vif_df) <- NULL
    vif_df <- vif_df %>% select(Predictor, everything())
  } else {
    vif_df <- data.frame(
      Predictor = names(vif_vals),
      VIF = vif_vals,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  # Flag problematic VIF values
  if("VIF" %in% names(vif_df)) {
    vif_df$Flag <- ifelse(vif_df$VIF > 10, "⚠️  Severe",
                   ifelse(vif_df$VIF > 5,  "⚠️  Moderate",
                   "✓"))
  }
  
  print(vif_df)
  
  # Summary
  if("VIF" %in% names(vif_df)) {
    max_vif <- max(vif_df$VIF, na.rm = TRUE)
    n_severe <- sum(vif_df$VIF > 10, na.rm = TRUE)
    n_moderate <- sum(vif_df$VIF > 5 & vif_df$VIF <= 10, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n")
    cat(sprintf("Maximum VIF: %.2f\n", max_vif))
    cat(sprintf("Severe collinearity (VIF > 10): %d predictor(s)\n", n_severe))
    cat(sprintf("Moderate collinearity (5 < VIF ≤ 10): %d predictor(s)\n", n_moderate))
    
    if(max_vif < 5) {
      cat("\n✓ No evidence of problematic multicollinearity\n")
    } else if(max_vif < 10) {
      cat("\n⚠️  Moderate multicollinearity detected - interpret coefficients cautiously\n")
    } else {
      cat("\n⚠️  Severe multicollinearity detected - consider removing correlated predictors\n")
    }
  }
  
  vif_df
  
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("✗ VIF calculation failed (may indicate perfect collinearity)\n")
  cat(sprintf("  Error: %s\n", e$message))
  NULL
})

if(!is.null(vif_results)) {
  write_csv(vif_results, "vif_results.csv")
  cat("\n✓ Saved: vif_results.csv\n")
}

cat("\n")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PART C: INFLUENTIAL CASES DETECTION
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART C: INFLUENTIAL CASES DETECTION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Cook's Distance
cooksd <- cooks.distance(best_model)
threshold <- 4 / length(cooksd)

influential_df <- data.frame(
  Case_ID = 1:length(cooksd),
  Cooks_D = cooksd,
  Influential = cooksd > threshold
) %>%
  arrange(desc(Cooks_D))

n_influential <- sum(influential_df$Influential)

cat(sprintf("Cook's Distance threshold: %.5f\n", threshold))
cat(sprintf("Influential cases detected: %d (%.1f%%)\n\n", 
            n_influential, 100 * n_influential / nrow(influential_df)))

if(n_influential > 0) {
  cat("Top 10 influential cases:\n")
  print(head(influential_df, 10))
  
  # Save all influential cases
  influential_only <- influential_df %>% filter(Influential)
  write_csv(influential_only, "influential_cases.csv")
  cat(sprintf("\n✓ Saved: influential_cases.csv (%d cases)\n", nrow(influential_only)))
  
  # Sensitivity: Refit without influential cases
  if(n_influential <= 20 && n_influential > 0) {
    cat("\n─── Sensitivity Check: Model Without Influential Cases ───\n")
    
    df_cc_clean <- df_cc[-influential_df$Case_ID[influential_df$Influential], ]
    
    model_no_outliers <- tryCatch({
      glm(formula(best_model), data = df_cc_clean, family = binomial())
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("✗ Failed to refit model without influential cases\n")
      NULL
    })
    
    if(!is.null(model_no_outliers)) {
      # Compare key coefficients
      coef_original <- coef(best_model)
      coef_clean <- coef(model_no_outliers)
      
      # Focus on non-intercept terms
      coef_original <- coef_original[names(coef_original) != "(Intercept)"]
      coef_clean <- coef_clean[names(coef_clean) != "(Intercept)"]
      
      coef_compare <- data.frame(
        Predictor = names(coef_original),
        OR_with_influential = exp(coef_original),
        OR_without_influential = exp(coef_clean[names(coef_original)]),
        Percent_change = 100 * (exp(coef_clean[names(coef_original)]) - exp(coef_original)) / exp(coef_original)
      )
      
      cat("\nCoefficient comparison (OR scale):\n")
      print(coef_compare %>% arrange(desc(abs(Percent_change))) %>% head(10))
      
      max_change <- max(abs(coef_compare$Percent_change), na.rm = TRUE)
      
      if(max_change < 10) {
        cat("\n✓ Influential cases have minimal impact (max change < 10%)\n")
      } else if(max_change < 20) {
        cat("\n⚠️  Influential cases have moderate impact (max change 10-20%)\n")
      } else {
        cat("\n⚠️  Influential cases have substantial impact (max change > 20%)\n")
        cat("   Consider reporting results with and without these cases\n")
      }
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("✓ No influential cases detected\n")
}

cat("\n")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PART D: MODEL CALIBRATION
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART D: MODEL CALIBRATION\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Hosmer-Lemeshow Test
cat("Hosmer-Lemeshow Goodness-of-Fit Test:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")

fitted_probs <- fitted(best_model)
observed_outcome <- best_model$y

hl_test <- hoslem.test(observed_outcome, fitted_probs, g = 10)

cat(sprintf("Chi-square: %.3f\n", hl_test$statistic))
cat(sprintf("df: %d\n", hl_test$parameter))
cat(sprintf("p-value: %.4f\n\n", hl_test$p.value))

if(hl_test$p.value > 0.05) {
  cat("✓ Good calibration (p > 0.05 = fail to reject null of good fit)\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠️  Poor calibration (p < 0.05 = reject null of good fit)\n")
  cat("   Model may over/under-estimate probabilities in some ranges\n")
}

# Calibration Plot
cat("\n─── Calibration Plot ───\n")

# Create calibration data
calib_df <- data.frame(
  predicted = fitted_probs,
  observed = observed_outcome
) %>%
  mutate(pred_decile = ntile(predicted, 10)) %>%
  group_by(pred_decile) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_predicted = mean(predicted),
    mean_observed = mean(observed),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot
png("calibration_plot.png", width = 800, height = 600, res = 120)
ggplot(calib_df, aes(x = mean_predicted, y = mean_observed)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "blue", alpha = 0.2) +
  xlim(0, 1) + ylim(0, 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Calibration Plot",
    subtitle = sprintf("%s - Complete Case Analysis", best_model_name),
    x = "Mean Predicted Probability",
    y = "Mean Observed Proportion",
    size = "N per decile"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
dev.off()

cat("✓ Saved: calibration_plot.png\n\n")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PART E: CROSS-VALIDATION (INTERNAL VALIDATION)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART E: CROSS-VALIDATION (INTERNAL VALIDATION)\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Performing 10-fold cross-validation...\n")

# Prepare outcome as factor for caret
df_cc$outcome_fac <- factor(observed_outcome, 
                            levels = c(0, 1), 
                            labels = c("No", "Yes"))

# Set up cross-validation
set.seed(123)
train_control <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 10,
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
  savePredictions = "final"
)

# Fit model with CV
cv_model <- tryCatch({
  train(
    formula(best_model),
    data = df_cc,
    method = "glm",
    family = binomial(),
    trControl = train_control,
    metric = "ROC"
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("✗ Cross-validation failed\n")
  cat(sprintf("  Error: %s\n", e$message))
  NULL
})

if(!is.null(cv_model)) {
  # Calculate apparent AUC
  apparent_auc <- auc(roc(observed_outcome, fitted_probs, quiet = TRUE))
  cv_auc <- cv_model$results$ROC
  optimism <- apparent_auc - cv_auc
  
  cv_performance <- data.frame(
    Metric = c("Apparent AUC", "CV AUC", "Optimism", "Sensitivity", "Specificity"),
    Value = c(
      sprintf("%.3f", apparent_auc),
      sprintf("%.3f", cv_auc),
      sprintf("%.3f", optimism),
      sprintf("%.3f", cv_model$results$Sens),
      sprintf("%.3f", cv_model$results$Spec)
    )
  )
  
  cat("\nCross-Validation Results:\n")
  cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  print(cv_performance)
  
  cat("\n")
  if(optimism < 0.02) {
    cat("✓ Minimal optimism (< 0.02) - model generalizes well\n")
  } else if(optimism < 0.05) {
    cat("⚠️  Moderate optimism (0.02-0.05) - some overfitting present\n")
  } else {
    cat("⚠️  Substantial optimism (> 0.05) - considerable overfitting\n")
    cat("   Consider model simplification or larger sample\n")
  }
  
  write_csv(cv_performance, "cv_performance.csv")
  cat("\n✓ Saved: cv_performance.csv\n")
}

cat("\n")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PART F: LINEARITY ASSUMPTION CHECKS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART F: LINEARITY ASSUMPTION FOR CONTINUOUS PREDICTORS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("Checking linearity of continuous predictors in logit...\n\n")

# Get continuous predictors from model
model_terms <- attr(terms(best_model), "term.labels")
continuous_vars <- character()

for(var in model_terms) {
  if(var %in% names(df_cc)) {
    if(is.numeric(df_cc[[var]]) && n_distinct(df_cc[[var]]) > 5) {
      continuous_vars <- c(continuous_vars, var)
    }
  }
}

if(length(continuous_vars) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("Continuous predictors to check: %s\n\n", 
              paste(continuous_vars, collapse = ", ")))
  
  # Box-Tidwell test for each continuous predictor
  linearity_results <- list()
  
  for(var in continuous_vars) {
    cat(sprintf("Testing: %s\n", var))
    
    # Create interaction term with log of predictor
    # Skip if any values are <= 0 (can't take log)
    if(any(df_cc[[var]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      cat("  ⚠️  Contains non-positive values - transforming by adding constant\n")
      var_transformed <- df_cc[[var]] - min(df_cc[[var]], na.rm = TRUE) + 1
    } else {
      var_transformed <- df_cc[[var]]
    }
    
    df_cc_test <- df_cc
    df_cc_test$var_log_interaction <- df_cc_test[[var]] * log(var_transformed)
    
    # Fit model with interaction
    formula_test <- update(formula(best_model), 
                          ~ . + var_log_interaction)
    
    model_test <- tryCatch({
      glm(formula_test, data = df_cc_test, family = binomial())
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if(!is.null(model_test)) {
      coef_interaction <- summary(model_test)$coefficients["var_log_interaction", ]
      p_val <- coef_interaction[4]
      
      linearity_results[[var]] <- data.frame(
        Predictor = var,
        Interaction_p = p_val,
        Linearity = ifelse(p_val > 0.05, "✓ Linear", "⚠️  Non-linear")
      )
      
      cat(sprintf("  p-value for interaction term: %.4f %s\n", 
                  p_val, 
                  ifelse(p_val > 0.05, "✓", "⚠️")))
    } else {
      cat("  ✗ Test failed\n")
    }
    cat("\n")
  }
  
  if(length(linearity_results) > 0) {
    linearity_df <- bind_rows(linearity_results)
    
    n_linear <- sum(linearity_df$Interaction_p > 0.05)
    cat(sprintf("Summary: %d/%d predictors show linear relationship with log-odds\n",
                n_linear, nrow(linearity_df)))
    
    if(any(linearity_df$Interaction_p < 0.05)) {
      cat("\n⚠️  Non-linear relationships detected. Consider:\n")
      cat("   - Polynomial terms (e.g., age + age^2)\n")
      cat("   - Splines (restricted cubic splines)\n")
      cat("   - Categorization (though loses information)\n")
    }
  }
  
  # Component + Residual Plots
  cat("\n─── Creating Component + Residual Plots ───\n")
  
  png("linearity_checks.png", width = 1200, height = 800, res = 120)
  par(mfrow = c(2, min(3, ceiling(length(continuous_vars)/2))))
  
  for(var in continuous_vars) {
    tryCatch({
      crPlot(best_model, variable = var, 
             main = paste("C+R Plot:", var),
             col = "blue", col.lines = "red")
    }, error = function(e) {
      plot.new()
      text(0.5, 0.5, paste("Error plotting", var))
    })
  }
  
  dev.off()
  cat("✓ Saved: linearity_checks.png\n")
  
} else {
  cat("ℹ️  No continuous predictors found in model\n")
}

cat("\n")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PART G: MISSING DATA PATTERN ANALYSIS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART G: MISSING DATA PATTERN ANALYSIS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Select variables used in analysis
analysis_vars <- c("scrn_stopped_bzra", model_terms)
analysis_vars <- analysis_vars[analysis_vars %in% names(df_original)]

df_missing <- df_original %>% select(all_of(analysis_vars))

# Missing data summary
missing_summary <- df_missing %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "N_Missing") %>%
  mutate(
    Pct_Missing = 100 * N_Missing / nrow(df_original),
    Total_N = nrow(df_original)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(N_Missing))

cat("Missing data summary:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
print(missing_summary)

cat(sprintf("\nOverall missingness: %.1f%% of all analysis variable cells\n",
            100 * sum(is.na(df_missing)) / (nrow(df_missing) * ncol(df_missing))))

# Visualize missing patterns
cat("\n─── Creating Missing Data Visualizations ───\n")

png("missing_data_pattern.png", width = 1000, height = 800, res = 120)

# Create upset plot
tryCatch({
  gg_miss_upset(df_missing, nsets = min(10, ncol(df_missing)))
}, error = function(e) {
  # Fallback: simple heatmap
  vis_miss(df_missing) + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
})

dev.off()
cat("✓ Saved: missing_data_pattern.png\n\n")

# Test for MCAR (Little's test would be ideal, but complex to implement)
# Instead, test if missingness is associated with observed variables
cat("─── Testing MAR vs MCAR Assumption ───\n")
cat("Checking if missingness is predicted by observed variables...\n\n")

# Create missingness indicator for variables with >5% missing
high_missing_vars <- missing_summary %>%
  filter(Pct_Missing > 5, Variable != "scrn_stopped_bzra") %>%
  pull(Variable)

if(length(high_missing_vars) > 0) {
  for(var in high_missing_vars[1:min(3, length(high_missing_vars))]) {
    df_original$is_missing <- is.na(df_original[[var]])
    
    # Test with outcome
    if("scrn_stopped_bzra" %in% names(df_original)) {
      tab <- table(df_original$scrn_stopped_bzra, df_original$is_missing, useNA = "no")
      if(nrow(tab) > 1 && ncol(tab) > 1) {
        chi_test <- chisq.test(tab)
        cat(sprintf("%s missing vs outcome: χ² = %.2f, p = %.4f %s\n",
                    var, chi_test$statistic, chi_test$p.value,
                    ifelse(chi_test$p.value < 0.05, "⚠️", "✓")))
      }
    }
  }
  
  if(any(sapply(high_missing_vars[1:min(3, length(high_missing_vars))], function(v) {
    df_original$is_missing <- is.na(df_original[[v]])
    tab <- table(df_original$scrn_stopped_bzra, df_original$is_missing, useNA = "no")
    if(nrow(tab) > 1 && ncol(tab) > 1) {
      chisq.test(tab)$p.value < 0.05
    } else {
      FALSE
    }
  }))) {
    cat("\n⚠️  Missingness associated with observed variables → MAR plausible\n")
    cat("   This supports use of multiple imputation\n")
  } else {
    cat("\n✓ No strong evidence against MCAR, though sample size may limit power\n")
  }
}

cat("\n")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PART H: SAMPLE SIZE & POWER ASSESSMENT
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART H: SAMPLE SIZE & POWER ASSESSMENT\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Events per variable rule
n_events <- sum(observed_outcome)
n_predictors <- length(coef(best_model)) - 1  # Exclude intercept
epv <- n_events / n_predictors

cat("Events-Per-Variable (EPV) Analysis:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat(sprintf("Number of events: %d\n", n_events))
cat(sprintf("Number of predictors: %d\n", n_predictors))
cat(sprintf("EPV: %.1f\n\n", epv))

if(epv >= 10) {
  cat("✓ EPV ≥ 10 (traditional rule of thumb met)\n")
} else if(epv >= 5) {
  cat("⚠️  EPV 5-10 (acceptable but may have reduced power)\n")
  cat("   Consider model simplification if unstable estimates observed\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠️  EPV < 5 (high risk of overfitting and unreliable estimates)\n")
  cat("   Strongly recommend reducing number of predictors\n")
}

# Effective sample size
cat("\n─── Effective Sample Size ───\n")
cat(sprintf("Total observations: %d\n", nrow(df_cc)))
cat(sprintf("Events (outcome = 1): %d (%.1f%%)\n", n_events, 100*n_events/nrow(df_cc)))
cat(sprintf("Non-events (outcome = 0): %d (%.1f%%)\n", 
            nrow(df_cc) - n_events, 
            100*(nrow(df_cc) - n_events)/nrow(df_cc)))

if(n_events < 50) {
  cat("\n⚠️  Fewer than 50 events - power may be limited for detecting effects\n")
} else if(n_events < 100) {
  cat("\n⚠️  50-100 events - adequate for main effects but limited for interactions\n")
} else {
  cat("\n✓ Adequate sample size for logistic regression\n")
}

cat("\n")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PART I: COMPREHENSIVE DIAGNOSTIC SUMMARY
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART I: DIAGNOSTIC SUMMARY REPORT\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Compile all results
diagnostic_summary <- data.frame(
  Check = character(),
  Result = character(),
  Flag = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# VIF
if(!is.null(vif_results) && "VIF" %in% names(vif_results)) {
  max_vif <- max(vif_results$VIF, na.rm = TRUE)
  diagnostic_summary <- bind_rows(diagnostic_summary, data.frame(
    Check = "Multicollinearity (max VIF)",
    Result = sprintf("%.2f", max_vif),
    Flag = ifelse(max_vif < 5, "✓", ifelse(max_vif < 10, "⚠️", "⚠️⚠️"))
  ))
}

# Influential cases
diagnostic_summary <- bind_rows(diagnostic_summary, data.frame(
  Check = "Influential cases (% of sample)",
  Result = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * n_influential / nrow(df_cc)),
  Flag = ifelse(n_influential == 0, "✓", 
         ifelse(n_influential < 0.05 * nrow(df_cc), "⚠️", "⚠️⚠️"))
))

# Calibration
diagnostic_summary <- bind_rows(diagnostic_summary, data.frame(
  Check = "Hosmer-Lemeshow p-value",
  Result = sprintf("%.3f", hl_test$p.value),
  Flag = ifelse(hl_test$p.value > 0.05, "✓", "⚠️")
))

# Cross-validation
if(!is.null(cv_model)) {
  diagnostic_summary <- bind_rows(diagnostic_summary, data.frame(
    Check = "Optimism (apparent - CV AUC)",
    Result = sprintf("%.3f", optimism),
    Flag = ifelse(optimism < 0.02, "✓", 
           ifelse(optimism < 0.05, "⚠️", "⚠️⚠️"))
  ))
}

# EPV
diagnostic_summary <- bind_rows(diagnostic_summary, data.frame(
  Check = "Events per variable",
  Result = sprintf("%.1f", epv),
  Flag = ifelse(epv >= 10, "✓", 
         ifelse(epv >= 5, "⚠️", "⚠️⚠️"))
))

cat("DIAGNOSTIC SUMMARY:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
print(diagnostic_summary)

write_csv(diagnostic_summary, "model_diagnostics_summary.csv")
cat("\n✓ Saved: model_diagnostics_summary.csv\n")

# Create text report
report_text <- c(
  "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
  "MODEL DIAGNOSTICS REPORT",
  sprintf("Model: %s", best_model_name),
  sprintf("Date: %s", Sys.Date()),
  "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
  "",
  "SUMMARY:",
  ""
)

# Determine overall assessment
n_pass <- sum(diagnostic_summary$Flag == "✓")
n_warn <- sum(str_detect(diagnostic_summary$Flag, "⚠️"))

if(n_warn == 0) {
  overall <- "✓ ALL DIAGNOSTICS PASSED - Model is robust"
} else if(n_warn <= 2) {
  overall <- "⚠️  MINOR ISSUES DETECTED - Model generally acceptable"
} else {
  overall <- "⚠️⚠️  MULTIPLE ISSUES DETECTED - Consider model revision"
}

report_text <- c(report_text, overall, "")

# Add details
for(i in 1:nrow(diagnostic_summary)) {
  report_text <- c(report_text,
                  sprintf("%s %s: %s",
                          diagnostic_summary$Flag[i],
                          diagnostic_summary$Check[i],
                          diagnostic_summary$Result[i]))
}

report_text <- c(report_text,
  "",
  "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
  "KEY RECOMMENDATIONS:",
  "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════"
)

# Add recommendations based on flags
recommendations <- c()

if(!is.null(vif_results) && "VIF" %in% names(vif_results)) {
  if(max(vif_results$VIF, na.rm = TRUE) > 10) {
    recommendations <- c(recommendations,
      "• Remove or combine highly correlated predictors (VIF > 10)")
  }
}

if(n_influential > 0.05 * nrow(df_cc)) {
  recommendations <- c(recommendations,
    "• Investigate influential cases - consider sensitivity analysis without them")
}

if(hl_test$p.value < 0.05) {
  recommendations <- c(recommendations,
    "• Model shows poor calibration - consider recalibration or model revision")
}

if(!is.null(cv_model) && optimism > 0.05) {
  recommendations <- c(recommendations,
    "• Substantial optimism detected - consider model simplification",
    "• Report cross-validated performance estimates rather than apparent AUC")
}

if(epv < 10) {
  recommendations <- c(recommendations,
    "• Low EPV - consider reducing number of predictors or combining with external validation")
}

if(length(recommendations) == 0) {
  recommendations <- "• No major concerns - model meets standard diagnostic criteria"
}

report_text <- c(report_text, recommendations)

report_text <- c(report_text,
  "",
  "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
  "END OF REPORT",
  "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════"
)

writeLines(report_text, "diagnostics_report.txt")
cat("\n✓ Saved: diagnostics_report.txt\n\n")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# FINAL SUMMARY
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("DIAGNOSTIC ANALYSIS COMPLETE\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("OUTPUT FILES CREATED:\n")
cat("  1. vif_results.csv                ← Multicollinearity assessment\n")
cat("  2. influential_cases.csv          ← Cases with high Cook's D\n")
cat("  3. calibration_plot.png           ← Calibration visualization\n")
cat("  4. cv_performance.csv             ← Cross-validation metrics\n")
cat("  5. linearity_checks.png           ← Component+residual plots\n")
cat("  6. missing_data_pattern.png       ← Missingness visualization\n")
cat("  7. model_diagnostics_summary.csv  ← Summary table\n")
cat("  8. diagnostics_report.txt         ← Comprehensive report\n\n")

cat(overall, "\n\n")

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
```


## Influential Case Analysis

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# INFLUENTIAL CASES SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS
#==============================================================================
# Purpose: Examine impact of influential cases on key findings
# Strategy: Refit models without high Cook's D cases and compare
#==============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(pROC)

cat("\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("INFLUENTIAL CASES SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART A: LOAD DATA AND IDENTIFY INFLUENTIAL CASES
#==============================================================================

cat("PART A: Loading data and identifying influential cases\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n")

# Load complete-case models
cc_models <- readRDS("cc_model_results.rds")

# Focus on Model_3 (best EPV: 8 predictors)
best_model <- cc_models$Model_3
model_name <- "Model_3"

cat(sprintf("Analyzing: %s (VSURF Personality only)\n", model_name))
cat(sprintf("Formula: %s\n\n", deparse(formula(best_model))))

# Get data
df_cc <- best_model$model
n_total <- nrow(df_cc)

# Calculate Cook's Distance
cooksd <- cooks.distance(best_model)
threshold <- 4 / n_total

# Identify influential cases
influential_df <- data.frame(
  Case_ID = 1:length(cooksd),
  Cooks_D = cooksd,
  Influential = cooksd > threshold
) %>%
  arrange(desc(Cooks_D))

n_influential <- sum(influential_df$Influential)

cat(sprintf("Cook's Distance threshold: %.5f (4/n)\n", threshold))
cat(sprintf("Influential cases identified: %d (%.1f%% of sample)\n\n", 
            n_influential, 100 * n_influential / n_total))

# Show top 10
cat("Top 10 cases by Cook's Distance:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
print(head(influential_df, 10))
cat("\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART B: EXAMINE CHARACTERISTICS OF INFLUENTIAL CASES
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART B: CHARACTERISTICS OF INFLUENTIAL CASES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

# Add Cook's D to data
df_cc$cooks_d <- cooksd
df_cc$influential <- cooksd > threshold

# Compare influential vs non-influential
comparison <- df_cc %>%
  group_by(influential) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    outcome_rate = mean(scrn_stopped_bzra) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("Outcome distribution:\n")
print(comparison)
cat("\n")

# Check if influential cases are disproportionately one outcome
outcome_tab <- table(df_cc$influential, df_cc$scrn_stopped_bzra)
cat("Outcome by influential status:\n")
print(outcome_tab)

if(sum(outcome_tab[2,]) > 0) {
  chi_test <- chisq.test(outcome_tab)
  cat(sprintf("\nChi-square test: χ² = %.2f, p = %.4f\n", 
              chi_test$statistic, chi_test$p.value))
  
  if(chi_test$p.value < 0.05) {
    cat("⚠️  Influential cases differ in outcome distribution\n")
  } else {
    cat("✓ Influential cases similar in outcome distribution\n")
  }
}

cat("\n")

#==============================================================================
# PART C: REFIT MODEL WITHOUT INFLUENTIAL CASES
#==============================================================================

cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("PART C: REFITTING MODEL WITHOUT INFLUENTIAL CASES\n")
```
